obligations.action_summary: Develop, establish and implement a public awareness campaign promoting the New York state job bank and related programs, to begin within ninety days of the effective date.
obligations.quote: The department of labor shall develop, establish and implement a public awareness campaign promoting the New York state job bank, as well as any other related programs the commissioner of labor deems appropriate.
obligations.deadline_text: The campaign shall begin no later than ninety days after the effective date of this act.
obligations.law_title: Authorizes the department of labor to develop a public awareness campaign promoting the New York state job bank

obligations.action_summary: Report annually to the governor and the legislature on actions taken for the campaign and the appropriations needed next fiscal year.
obligations.quote: The department of labor shall prepare an annual report to the governor and the legislature within one year after this act shall have become a law and thereafter annually on or before December first of each year on the public awareness campaign
obligations.deadline_text: within one year after this act shall have become a law and thereafter annually on or before December first of each year
obligations.law_title: Authorizes the department of labor to develop a public awareness campaign promoting the New York state job bank

obligations.action_summary: Make the contact details of department-approved training programs that offer competency exams to home health aides available on the department's website.
obligations.quote: The department shall make the contact details of department-approved education or training programs that offer competency exams to home health aides available on the department's website and readily accessible by the public.
obligations.law_title: Relates to providing information regarding competency exams offered to qualified home health aides

obligations.action_summary: Disclose fund withdrawals consistently with the district's other reserve fund disclosures, including the property tax report card.
obligations.quote: Withdrawals from the fund shall be disclosed in a manner consistent with the required disclosures of similar reserve funds held by the district
obligations.law_title: Establishes a wind energy systems tax stabilization reserve fund in the Copenhagen Central School District to lessen or prevent increases in the school district's real property tax levy

obligations.actor_raw: The moneys in the wind energy systems tax stabilization reserve fund
obligations.action_summary: Deposit, invest and account for the fund's moneys as the education law provides.
obligations.quote: The moneys in the wind energy systems tax stabilization reserve fund shall be deposited, invested and accounted for in the manner provided for in subdivisions 2 and 6 of section 3651 and section 3652 of the education law.
obligations.law_title: Establishes a wind energy systems tax stabilization reserve fund in the Copenhagen Central School District to lessen or prevent increases in the school district's real property tax levy

obligations.action_summary: Report annually to the temporary president of the senate and the speaker of the assembly on topics discussed at state charter advisory board meetings and related legislative recommendations.
obligations.quote: The superintendent shall make an annual report no later than thirty days after the end of each year to the temporary president of the senate and the speaker of the assembly
obligations.deadline_text: no later than thirty days after the end of each year
obligations.law_title: Provides for reporting for the state charter advisory board and extends the effectiveness of such board

obligations.action_summary: Appoint up to fifteen members to the apiary industry advisory committee based on apiary industry experience and expertise.
obligations.quote: an apiary industry advisory committee which shall consist of no more than fifteen members to be appointed by the commissioner based on their experience and expertise in the apiary industry.
obligations.law_title: Relates to bee health and the beekeeping industry; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Advise the commissioner on state government plans, policies and programs affecting the apiary industry.
obligations.quote: The duties and responsibilities of the apiary industry advisory committee shall include providing advice, comments and recommendations to the commissioner regarding state government plans, policies and programs affecting the apiary industry
obligations.law_title: Relates to bee health and the beekeeping industry; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Meet at least once a year at times and places the commissioner sets.
obligations.quote: The advisory committee shall meet at least once annually, at times and places set by the commissioner.
obligations.law_title: Relates to bee health and the beekeeping industry; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Give a beekeeper reasonable advance notice of any apiary inspection.
obligations.quote: The commissioner shall provide a beekeeper or such beekeeper's designated agent with reasonable advance notice of any inspection of an apiary.
obligations.law_title: Relates to bee health and the beekeeping industry; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Create a cooperative honey bee health improvement program that requires beekeepers to report colony counts and locations annually.
obligations.quote: the commissioner shall create a cooperative honey bee health improvement program which will require that:
obligations.law_title: Relates to bee health and the beekeeping industry; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Use beekeeper data to tell beekeepers and bee clubs about disease and parasite incidence by county and about possible movement, sale or destruction orders.
obligations.quote: The department shall use this information to communicate the incidence of infectious diseases and parasites at the county level to beekeepers and bee clubs and to notify beekeepers of the potential need for the department to prohibit the movement or selling of diseased or infested bees or require the destruction of such bees.
obligations.law_title: Relates to bee health and the beekeeping industry; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Inspect annually the apiaries of anyone selling nucleus colonies or queens, to check for American Foulbrood and other disease levels.
obligations.quote: must first have an inspection of its apiaries, as authorized by section one hundred seventy-three-b of this article, by the department which inspections shall continue on an annual basis, so long as nucs or queens are offered for sale.
obligations.law_title: Relates to bee health and the beekeeping industry; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Take samples for laboratory testing when American Foulbrood symptoms persist on re-inspection.
obligations.quote: If upon re-inspection, symptoms of American Foulbrood are found to persist, the prohibition from selling nucs and queens shall continue, and the department shall take samples for laboratory testing for the continued presence of American Foulbrood.
obligations.law_title: Relates to bee health and the beekeeping industry; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Promptly notify a seller of test results and the end of the sales prohibition when samples test free of American Foulbrood.
obligations.quote: Should the laboratory test results show the samples free from American Foulbrood, the department shall promptly notify the individual or business of the test results and the termination of the prohibition of the sale of nucs and queens.
obligations.law_title: Relates to bee health and the beekeeping industry; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Establish by regulation the disease and parasite tolerances and the bee species determinations that trigger a beekeeper's duty to report.
obligations.quote: such tolerances and determinations to be established in regulation by the commissioner
obligations.law_title: Relates to bee health and the beekeeping industry; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Publish allowable disease and parasite tolerances and bee species information on the department's website.
obligations.quote: Information regarding allowable disease and parasite tolerances and species and subspecies of bees shall be made available on the department's website.
obligations.law_title: Relates to bee health and the beekeeping industry; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Give any person believed to have violated the bee diseases article written notice of the alleged violation and an opportunity to be heard.
obligations.quote: Any person believed to have violated any provision of this article shall receive written notice of such alleged violation and an opportunity to be heard to dispute such alleged violation.
obligations.law_title: Relates to bee health and the beekeeping industry; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Advise the beekeeper in each destruction order or sales prohibition notice of the right to a hearing and how to request it.
obligations.quote: The order or notification shall advise the beekeeper of the right to such hearing, the procedure to be followed and the manner in which the request may be made to the commissioner
obligations.law_title: Relates to bee health and the beekeeping industry; repealer

obligations.action_summary: Give the beekeeper ten days' written notice of a hearing on the record to show cause why the destruction, treatment or sales prohibition is not appropriate.
obligations.quote: Upon receipt of such request, the commissioner shall give the beekeeper ten days' notice in writing of a hearing for the beekeeper to show cause why the destruction, treatment or prohibition on selling by the order or notification is not appropriate. The hearing shall be held on the record
obligations.law_title: Relates to bee health and the beekeeping industry; repealer
